Hello All,

I just open sourced my code for FDA event dashboard @ https://github.com/abhik1368/fda-dashboard_v.2.0.0 

I would love to have some feedbacks. I know long time back FDA have R shiny apps but overall their apps looks a bit clunky to me . So I started to work on it and came up with more professional version . It doesn't serve everything but an intitial start. Thanks to shiny dashboard package, rCharts library and last but not the least Shiny developers.

Cheers,
Abhik
